default.text-title: I stepped outside my comfort zone.
default.editor-body: I had such a great experience with JJ! We visited around 4–5 different shops, and she picked out complete outfits for me while also letting me browse and try things on myself. I especially loved that she chose pieces I normally wouldn't pick — exactly what I wanted to step outside my usual style and discover something new. She gave me honest feedback and styling tips without ever being pushy about buying anything. I ended up falling in love with so many pieces! Thank you so much, JJ! I'd definitely recommend her if you want to explore your style and get out of your comfort zone.

default.text-title: They really went above and beyond.
default.editor-body: I came with no expectations but had a great time. I wasn't expecting to really buy anything because I'm really picky, but Jisu and Jiwon have really great style opinions. They really went above and beyond. Definitely a great experience!

default.text-title: Everything looked super cute and stylish together.
default.editor-body: Luna is extremely professional! She clearly understood my preferred style and selected many clothes and accessories that matched my taste. On top of my usual style, she added subtle details I wouldn't normally notice — everything looked super cute and stylish together! She was incredibly patient and recommended many fantastic makeup and skincare products. Plus, she is absolutely gorgeous and so nice in person! I had a wonderful experience and am very satisfied. Thank you so much to the team for such a thoughtful arrangement!

default.text-title: She understood exactly what I wanted.
default.editor-body: A fantastic experience! I had a wonderful time with Jade during a shopping session. She is lovely, very kind, a great listener, and truly helped me find an outfit suitable for my work, all while respecting my tastes and personality. Thanks to her, I also discovered some beautiful boutiques I didn't know about. The shopping was efficient, enjoyable, and truly friendly. We chatted and laughed a lot and had a great time! I highly recommend her without hesitation and would gladly use her services again for another shopping session!

default.text-title: Every single try-on was a success.
default.editor-body: Luna was a perfect host. I received a very warm welcome, and her explanations about how the activity would proceed were clear. I chose the most comprehensive package, and she tailored it to my needs, focusing more on the elements that mattered most to me: outfits and natural skincare/makeup. There was no need to try on 50,000 outfits to find one I liked. Every single try-on was successful for me. Luna truly has an eye for style: she understood my needs and tastes very well, while also managing to get me to try things I wouldn't necessarily have chosen myself at first, and which I ended up loving. Honestly, I would be happy to repeat this experience in another season for new outfits.

default.text-title: It felt like shopping with a friend.
default.editor-body: My brother and I booked the 2:1 package, and it was a really awesome experience, heavily recommend. JJ was incredibly kind, always open to questions, and had a great fashion sense. I've never been into shopping or thrifting, but I genuinely enjoyed the hours I spent. At first, we explored the style I liked in the survey. After some time, we realized it didn't fit me, and experimented with new outfits and ideas. I ended up with a lot more fashion knowledge, and I was quite happy with the outfits we found. JJ knew the area very well. She knew which shops specialized in what, she could grab multiple pieces of clothing much faster than a casual browser, and she would give instant feedback after we came out of the fitting rooms. If we couldn't afford a piece, then we would visit another store with a similar piece for cheaper. She has a great sense of humor, and it felt like hanging out with a friend :) We did use a translator at points, but it was never a burden. It was fun :)

default.text-title: Outfits I would never have picked myself.
default.editor-body: Had a great time trying out outfits and skincare with Yeonjae as my personal stylist! She chose great outfits for me that I wouldn't normally choose for myself based on my personal color analysis. She was very honest about how they looked and chose outfits that were very affordable too. Would highly recommend!

default.text-title: So much more than just shopping.
default.editor-body: I had an amazing time with Seoul Personal Styling Seongsu! As someone quite tall (190 cm / 6'3") who wears larger clothing sizes, especially pants, I was worried about finding clothes that fit me in Korea. But JJ did a fantastic job finding the right stores and outfits! She helped me choose clothes that suited my body type, explained how to mix and match different pieces, and gave genuinely useful fashion advice. It was much more than just shopping! Seongsu is full of trendy and unique stores, and JJ made exploring them so much easier and more enjoyable. She was incredibly kind, patient, and professional. Even though I'm a foreign tourist and we occasionally used translation apps, communication was easy and fun! I learned so much, found clothes I really liked, and had a wonderful experience. Highly recommend JJ, even if you're tall or wear larger sizes!

default.text-title: I'd love to book this experience again.
default.editor-body: JJ was very friendly and helpful in selecting new styles and outfit combinations that matched my color palette. I would love to book this experience again.

default.text-title: Honest advice, no pressure to buy.
default.editor-body: A super welcome, the stylist is very friendly and you won't have a dull moment. She doesn't hesitate to give you great advice, and you can choose whatever you like, with no obligation. I recommend her if you really don't know what to pick.
